<script>
  // The Google Doc renders at a fixed letter-page width, so scale it to fit narrow screens.
  (() => {
    const container = document.querySelector(".resume-container");
    const iframe = container.querySelector("iframe");
    const fit = () => { iframe.style.zoom = Math.min(1, container.clientWidth / 816); };
    new ResizeObserver(fit).observe(container);
  })();
</script>
